A list of web application scan configurations. If a scan has been run using the configuration, the list
also contains information about the last scan that was run.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
object (PaginationResponse)
An object containing pagination information for the current result set.
Array of objects (ConfigMetadata)
A list of scan configurations.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
